title: Ilayk
subtitle: You shared a prophecy, about me published poet; My turn to share with you, the vision - as you saw it\ -J

posts.title: What not to take
posts.description: Sometimes souls are meant to part Just to better meet once more I still love you, and to the core I’ll take for you a poisoned dart

posts.title: Your soles
posts.description: I still cherish the ground upon which Your delicate soles make their way And although I do not have a say With your love I am plentiful rich And if ever someday there’s a glitch And without you I am meant to stay I shall live my whole life with no ray And to death will my heart stir and twitch

posts.title: Going through the motions
posts.description: Why do you pop in my day Just enough so I don’t get enough Longing for you to just stay These withdrawals are simply too tough
